behavior.arguments: rdi = candidate value; the two compared globals are read from .bss slots, whose runtime values are not in the file and are not claimed
behavior.branch_order: no branches inside the window; two unsigned setcc instructions feed one AND
behavior.low_byte_rule: (rax & 0xff) == 1 iff lo <= rdi < hi (unsigned), else 0; upper bytes of rax are NOT determined by this window because no instruction zeroes eax or ecx before the setcc/AND sequence
behavior.output_shape: rax low byte is the membership bit, then ret; callers test %al only

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

incoming_pattern_scan.caller_result_use: each caller tests %al only (test %al,%al) immediately after the call
